```bash
cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/hxddh/oprobe --tag v3.0.0 oprobe
```

## Updating

`oprobe self-update` checks GitHub Releases, downloads the archive for this platform, verifies it against
`SHA256SUMS`, checks that the new binary starts, and replaces the running one in place
(`oprobe self-update --check` only reports; `--to v3.0.1` picks a release; `-o json` for scripts). When
oprobe was installed by a package manager (Homebrew, apt/dnf, the `.pkg` or `.app`, Scoop, winget, the MSI,
cargo), it refuses and prints that manager's update command instead.

## Verifying downloads

```bash
sha256sum --ignore-missing -c SHA256SUMS                    # Linux
shasum -a 256 --ignore-missing -c SHA256SUMS                # macOS
Get-FileHash oprobe-3.0.0-x64.msi -Algorithm SHA256          # Windows
```

Every asset also has a [SLSA build provenance](https://slsa.dev/) attestation signed by GitHub Actions, which
proves it was built by this repository's release workflow from a given commit:

```bash
gh attestation verify oprobe-3.0.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz --repo hxddh/oprobe
```

## First open of unsigned packages

The project has no Apple or Microsoft code-signing certificate, so the `.pkg`, `.dmg` and `.msi` are **not
signed or notarized**. The operating system asks for one confirmation the first time:

- **macOS 15 (Sequoia) and later**: open `oprobe.app` (or the `.pkg`) once and close the warning; then open
  *System Settings → Privacy & Security*, scroll to the message about oprobe, click **Open Anyway** and
  confirm with your password. (Right-click → *Open* no longer skips the check on macOS 15.)
- **macOS 14 and earlier**: right-click `oprobe.app` → *Open* → *Open*.
- **Either, from a terminal**: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/oprobe.app`.
- **Windows**: SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC": click **More info** → **Run anyway**.

Homebrew, Scoop, winget, the install scripts, `cargo install` and the plain archives used from a terminal are
not affected. Verify the download (above) before you confirm.

## Shell completions (archives)

```bash
cp completions/oprobe.bash ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/oprobe   # bash
cp completions/_oprobe ~/.zfunc/                                               # zsh (a directory in $fpath)
cp completions/oprobe.fish ~/.config/fish/completions/                         # fish
. ./_oprobe.ps1                                                                # PowerShell ($PROFILE)
```

Packages (deb, rpm, pkg, Homebrew) install completions and man pages themselves. `oprobe completions SHELL`
and `oprobe man` generate them on any install.


<!-- source: docs/troubleshooting.md -->

# Troubleshooting

Start with the doctor:

```bash
oprobe target test prod            # a configured target
oprobe doctor s3://bucket/prefix   # any URL
```

It checks configuration, credentials, the network path (DNS, proxy, TCP, TLS, HTTP), clock skew and
list/write/read/stat/delete permissions one by one, and prints a fix for each failure (`--read-only` skips
the writes). Every error of every command carries a stable code (`-o json`: `error.code`) and usually a
`hint:` line.

## Errors

| Code / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `usage.unknown_target` | the name is not in the config file | `oprobe target list`; pass a URL; `oprobe target add NAME URL` |
| `usage.unknown_run` | no run matches the RUNREF | `oprobe runs list`; use more characters of the id |
| `config.invalid`, `config.unknown_option` | a typo in the config file or an option the service ignores | `oprobe config edit` (validated on save); the error names the closest valid option |
| `auth.no_credentials`, `auth.denied`, `AccessDenied`, `SignatureDoesNotMatch` | missing or wrong credentials, IAM | `--credentials profile:NAME`, export `AWS_*` / `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS` / `AZURE_STORAGE_*`; oprobe needs list/read/write/delete on the prefix — or measure read-only with `--existing PREFIX`, or `--anonymous` for public buckets |
| `net.tls`, `invalid peer certificate: UnknownIssuer` | private CA or a TLS-inspecting proxy | `--ca-cert corp.pem` (or `SSL_CERT_FILE`); `--insecure` for development endpoints only |
| `net.dns`, `no addresses` | wrong endpoint, or a network where only the proxy resolves names | check `--endpoint`; set `HTTPS_PROXY` |
| `net.unreachable`, `connection refused` | nothing listening | check the endpoint and port; is MinIO / `oprobe lab` running? |
| `proxy refused CONNECT` | egress proxy policy or credentials | check `HTTPS_PROXY` (with `user:pass@`), `NO_PROXY`, or `--proxy none` |
| `RequestTimeTooSkewed` | local clock off by > 15 min | enable NTP; `oprobe doctor` shows the skew |
| `PermanentRedirect`, `AuthorizationHeaderMalformed`, `region is missing` | wrong region | `--region` or `AWS_REGION`; R2 uses `auto` |
| `storage.throttled`, many 429 / 503 SlowDown | rate limiting | lower `-c` / `--max-inflight`, or `oprobe tune` |
| `safety.read_only` (exit 5) | a write under `--read-only` / `--existing` | drop the flag, or use a read-only preset |
| `safety.budget_exceeded` (exit 4) | a budget stopped the run | raise `--max-*`; the partial run is saved |
| exit 3 after a run | the SLA was breached (> 1% failed operations or corrupted data by default) or `--fail-on` matched | read the findings; `--sla none` reports without failing |

## Situations

| Situation | What to do |
|---|---|
| leftover `oprobe-run-*` prefixes | a run was killed (second Ctrl-C, OOM, power loss): `oprobe cleanup TARGET --dry-run`, then without `--dry-run` |
| "client processing-bound" on a remote store | client CPU, CRC verification or tiny objects: check `client cpu` in `runs show --detail`; `--no-verify`; larger objects |
| `oprobe run` asks questions in a script | it never does: prompts appear only on an interactive terminal with text output; pass a target, or `--non-interactive` |
| `oprobe top` fails in CI | it needs an interactive terminal; use `oprobe run` |
| `cannot open a window` / `built without native windows` | Linux server packages are headless: `oprobe top`, the `oprobe-desktop` tarball, or `cargo install oprobe --features gui` |
| `runs open` says no display | over SSH: `oprobe runs show RUNREF`, or `oprobe top --open FILE` in the terminal |
| `config edit` opens the wrong editor | set `VISUAL` or `EDITOR` (`export EDITOR="code -w"`) |
| `self-update` refuses | oprobe was installed by a package manager; the message names its update command (`brew upgrade oprobe`, `winget upgrade oprobe`, …) |
| `self-update` rate limited | GitHub's anonymous API limit: wait an hour or set `GITHUB_TOKEN` |
| macOS: "cannot be opened because the developer cannot be verified" / Windows SmartScreen | the packages are unsigned: [first open](install.md#first-open-of-unsigned-packages) |

[Reading the report](reading-the-report.md) explains each verdict and section.


<!-- source: docs/privacy.md -->

# Privacy

**oprobe sends no telemetry.** No usage statistics, crash reports or analytics, and no setting to turn any on.

## What oprobe connects to

| When | Where |
|---|---|
| `run`, `tune`, `doctor`, `target test`, `probe`, `watch`, `matrix`, `compat`, `cleanup`, the app | the storage endpoint you give it (and your proxy, if `HTTPS_PROXY` / `--proxy` is set); credential providers of that cloud (instance metadata, STS, SSO) when the provider chain needs them |
| `demo`, `lab`, `lab://…` targets | nothing: the lab runs inside oprobe on 127.0.0.1 |
| `self-update` | `api.github.com` and GitHub's release download host (set `OPROBE_UPDATE_API` to use a mirror) |
| the GitHub Action | GitHub (to download a pinned release and comment on the pull request) |

Nothing else. The HTML report is one self-contained file: opening it loads nothing from the network.

## What oprobe stores

- **Runs** in `<data dir>/oprobe/runs/` (`oprobe config path`): the report, the resolved configuration and one
  row per operation and request. Object keys, request IDs and remote IP addresses are part of a run; secrets
  are not: credential options (`secret_access_key`, `account_key`, `sas_token`, `password`, `*_key`, …) are
  redacted before anything is printed or saved, and URLs lose embedded credentials and query strings.
- **The host** is recorded as OS, architecture, CPU count and a hash of the host name, never the name itself.
- **The config file** holds what you put there (`oprobe target add` stores the URL, region, endpoint, the
  credential *source* such as `profile:prod`, and options — never keys unless you write them yourself).

Delete runs with `oprobe runs rm` / `oprobe runs gc`, or remove the data directory.

## Test data in your bucket

`oprobe run` writes under `<prefix>/oprobe-run-<id>/` and deletes it at the end, verifying the prefix is empty.
`--read-only` and `--existing` never write; `--dry-run` sends nothing. Leftovers from killed runs are listed
and removed with `oprobe cleanup TARGET --dry-run` / `oprobe cleanup TARGET`.


<!-- source: docs/cli.md -->

# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by `oprobe man --markdown` from the command definitions; do not edit by hand. Refresh: `OPROBE_BLESS=1 cargo test --test docs`. -->

oprobe drives realistic workloads through Apache OpenDAL and traces every backend request: queue wait, DNS/TCP/TLS handshakes, request send, time-to-first-byte, transfer and consumer stall. It explains the bottleneck, projects the cloud bill, tunes the client configuration and gates regressions in CI.

Every command accepts the global options below. Exit codes: `0` ok · `1` runtime failure · `2` usage/config · `3` SLA failed or regression · `4` budget exceeded · `5` safety refusal · `130` interrupted.

## Global options

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `-o, --output <OUTPUT>` | Output format of the result on stdout (logs and progress go to stderr) · one of `text`, `json`, `ndjson`, `md`, `html` · env `OPROBE_OUTPUT` |
| `--color <COLOR>` | When to use colors · one of `auto`, `always`, `never` · default `auto` |
| `-q, --quiet` | No progress or informational messages on stderr |
| `--non-interactive` | Never prompt or redraw (implied when stdin/stdout is not a terminal) |
| `--config <PATH>` | Config file (default: $OPROBE_CONFIG or <config dir>/oprobe/config.toml) |

## Commands

| command | what it does |
|---|---|
| [`oprobe run`](#oprobe-run) | Measure a target: where time and money go (saves the run) |
| [`oprobe demo`](#oprobe-demo) | Start a lab target with throttling and stragglers, run it and narrate the result |
| [`oprobe tune`](#oprobe-tune) | Find the best client configuration for a workload (throttle-aware) |
| [`oprobe compare`](#oprobe-compare) | Regression gate: compare two runs (RUNREFs or files) and fail on regressions |
| [`oprobe runs`](#oprobe-runs) | Saved runs: list, show, open, export, rm, gc |
| [`oprobe analyze`](#oprobe-analyze) | Re-slice a run by API, connection, remote, stage or second |
| [`oprobe explain`](#oprobe-explain) | Narrate a run's causes and advice, or document a finding code |
| [`oprobe target`](#oprobe-target) | Named targets: add, list, show, rm, test |
| [`oprobe doctor`](#oprobe-doctor) | Check endpoint reachability, TLS, clock skew, credentials and permissions |
| [`oprobe probe`](#oprobe-probe) | Measure DNS / TCP / proxy / TLS handshakes and cold vs warm TTFB of an endpoint |
| [`oprobe watch`](#oprobe-watch) | Continuous low-rate probing with SLOs and a Prometheus endpoint |
| [`oprobe matrix`](#oprobe-matrix) | Run the same workload across targets / knob values and rank them |
| [`oprobe compat`](#oprobe-compat) | Correctness & compatibility suite for a target |
| [`oprobe baseline`](#oprobe-baseline) | Named baselines: set, list, rm, show |
| [`oprobe lab`](#oprobe-lab) | Start a local S3-compatible server with programmable faults |
| [`oprobe mcp`](#oprobe-mcp) | MCP server for agents (stdio, or --http ADDR) |
| [`oprobe schema`](#oprobe-schema) | Print the JSON Schema of a machine output (report, events, …) |
| [`oprobe capabilities`](#oprobe-capabilities) | Describe what this oprobe can do (machine-readable) |
| [`oprobe config`](#oprobe-config) | Configuration: show (with sources), path, edit |
| [`oprobe cleanup`](#oprobe-cleanup) | Remove test data left behind by interrupted runs |
| [`oprobe self-update`](#oprobe-self-update) | Check, download, verify and install the latest release |
| [`oprobe top`](#oprobe-top) | Interactive workbench in this terminal: run, tune and probe with live charts |
| [`oprobe gui`](#oprobe-gui) | The same workbench in a native window (macOS, Windows, Linux with GTK 4) |
| [`oprobe completions`](#oprobe-completions) | Generate shell completions |
| [`oprobe man`](#oprobe-man) | Generate the man page |

## `oprobe run`

Measure a target: where time and money go (saves the run)

```text
oprobe run [OPTIONS] [TARGET]
```

*Target*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `<TARGET>` | Target name (see `oprobe target list`) or storage URL: s3://bucket/prefix, gcs://bucket, azblob://container, oss://, cos://, b2://, fs:///path, memory:// |
| `-p, --profile <FILE>` | Load a profile (TOML); flags override its values |
| `--endpoint <ENDPOINT>` | Custom endpoint (MinIO, R2, Ceph, private clouds) |
| `--region <REGION>` | Region of the bucket (e.g. us-east-1); most S3-compatible services accept any value |
| `--option <KEY=VALUE>` | Extra backend option, repeatable (e.g. --option enable_virtual_host_style=true) |
| `--anonymous` | Access a public bucket without credentials (s3, gcs, azblob, oss: unsigned requests) |
| `--ca-cert <PEM>` | Trust an extra PEM CA bundle |
| `--insecure` | Skip TLS certificate verification (development only) |
| `--proxy <PROXY>` | Egress proxy URL, or `none` to ignore HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY |

*Workload*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--preset <PRESET>` | Workload preset: parquet, checkpoint, small-files, metadata, mixed |
| `-d, --duration <DURATION>` | Measurement window (e.g. 30s, 2m) |
| `--warmup <WARMUP>` | Warmup before measuring (connections, caches) |
| `--max-ops <MAX_OPS>` | Stop after N measured operations |
| `--rate <RATE>` | Open-loop arrival rate (ops/s); latency is measured from the intended start time |
| `--existing <PREFIX>` | Benchmark existing objects under this prefix (read-only) |
| `--objects <OBJECTS>` | Number of dataset objects to generate |
| `--object-size <OBJECT_SIZE>` | Size of each generated object (e.g. 16MiB) |
| `--access <ACCESS>` | Key popularity: uniform, zipf:1.1, hotset:0.2/0.8 |
| `--persist-dataset` | Keep the generated dataset for later runs (oprobe-dataset/<fingerprint>/) |
| `--no-verify` | Skip CRC32C verification |
| `--keep-data` | Do not delete test data when the run ends |

*Client knobs*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `-c, --concurrency <CONCURRENCY>` | Concurrent operations (workers) |
| `--io-concurrency <IO_CONCURRENCY>` | Per-operation reader/writer parallelism |
| `--chunk-size <CHUNK_SIZE>` | Reader/writer chunk and multipart part size (e.g. 8MiB) |
| `--range-gap <RANGE_GAP>` | Merge vectored ranges closer than this (e.g. 64KiB) |
| `--max-inflight <MAX_INFLIGHT>` | Cap in-flight HTTP requests (0 = unlimited) |
| `--http <HTTP>` | HTTP version · one of `auto`, `h1`, `h2` |
| `--no-keep-alive` | Open a new connection for every request |
| `--microscope` | Use oprobe's instrumented connection pool instead of OpenDAL's own HTTP client: exact pool queueing, per-dial DNS/TCP/proxy/TLS and HTTP/2 streams, at the cost of measuring a different client than production runs |
| `--cache <SIZE>` | Enable the in-memory read cache with this size (e.g. 512MiB) |
| `--retries <RETRIES>` | Retry attempts for temporary errors |
| `--tail-cut` | Cancel and retry straggler requests (TailCutLayer) |

*Cost*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--provider <PROVIDER>` | Pricing preset: aws-s3, gcs, azure-blob, cloudflare-r2, backblaze-b2, aliyun-oss |
| `--monthly-ops <MONTHLY_OPS>` | Logical operations per month to project costs for |
| `--egress-fraction <EGRESS_FRACTION>` | Fraction of downloads leaving the cloud (0..1) |
| `--stored-gib <STORED_GIB>` | Stored data in GiB |

*SLA (exit code 3 when breached)*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--sla <MODE>` | `none` reports the SLA verdict without failing the command · one of `enforce`, `none` |
| `--max-error-rate <RATE>` | Max share of failed operations, e.g. 1% or 0.01 (default 1%) |
| `--max-throttle-rate <RATE>` | Max share of throttled (429/503) operations, e.g. 0% (default: not checked by `run`; `tune` rejects any throttling) |
| `--p99-ms <MS>` | Max p99 latency per operation in ms (tune rejects trials above it) |

*Output*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--json <FILE>` | Also save the report as JSON (input for `oprobe compare`) |
| `--markdown <FILE>` | Also save a Markdown report |
| `--no-save` | Do not save the run in the run store |
| `--fail-on <FAIL_ON>` | Also exit with code 3 if the diagnosis has findings of this severity or worse (SLA breaches always do, unless `--sla none`) · one of `warning`, `critical` |
| `--label <LABEL>` | Label stored in the report (e.g. a git SHA) |

*Safety*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | Print the plan (requests, bytes, objects written/deleted, cost, ETA) and exit |
| `--read-only` | Refuse every write and delete (exit 5); implied by --existing |
| `--max-cost-usd <USD>` | Stop when the estimated request cost exceeds this (USD; exit 4) |
| `--max-requests <N>` | Stop after this many backend requests (exit 4) |
| `--max-bytes <SIZE>` | Stop after transferring this many bytes, e.g. 10GiB (exit 4) |
| `--max-duration <DURATION>` | Stop after this much wall time, e.g. 5m (exit 4) |
| `--idempotency-key <KEY>` | Name the run prefix after KEY: a retried command reuses and cleans it up |
| `--repeat <N>` | Repeat the run N times and report the spread · default `1` |
| `--baseline <NAME>` | Compare against (and add to) a named baseline |

## `oprobe demo`

Start a lab target with throttling and stragglers, run it and narrate the result

```text
oprobe demo [OPTIONS]
```

## `oprobe tune`

Find the best client configuration for a workload (throttle-aware)

```text
oprobe tune [OPTIONS] [TARGET]
```

*Target*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `<TARGET>` | Target name (see `oprobe target list`) or storage URL: s3://bucket/prefix, gcs://bucket, azblob://container, oss://, cos://, b2://, fs:///path, memory:// |

| argument | description |
|---|---|

| `--max-cost-usd <USD>` | Stop when the estimated request cost exceeds this (USD; exit 4) |
| `--max-requests <N>` | Stop after this many backend requests (exit 4) |
| `--max-bytes <SIZE>` | Stop after transferring this many bytes, e.g. 10GiB (exit 4) |

| `--idempotency-key <KEY>` | Name the run prefix after KEY: a retried command reuses and cleans it up |

*Tuning*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--objective <OBJECTIVE>` | What to optimize · one of `throughput`, `latency`, `cost` · default `throughput` |
| `--trial-duration <TRIAL_DURATION>` | Measurement window per trial · default `5s` |
| `--trial-warmup <TRIAL_WARMUP>` | Warmup per trial · default `1s` |
| `--max-trials <MAX_TRIALS>` | Maximum number of trials · default `24` |
| `--max-concurrency <MAX_CONCURRENCY>` | Highest concurrency to try · default `256` |
| `--cooldown <COOLDOWN>` | Pause after a throttled trial · default `5s` |
| `--emit-profile <FILE>` | Write the tuned profile (TOML) |
| `--emit-rust <FILE>` | Write a Rust/OpenDAL snippet with the tuned settings |
| `--emit-python <FILE>` | Write a Python/OpenDAL snippet with the tuned settings |

## `oprobe compare`

Regression gate: compare two runs (RUNREFs or files) and fail on regressions

```text
oprobe compare [OPTIONS] [A] [B]
```

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `<A>` | Baseline: RUNREF (id, prefix, last~N, label) or a .oprobe / report .json file |
| `<B>` | Candidate: RUNREF or file (default: `last`) |
| `--baseline <NAME>` | Compare against a named baseline instead of A |
| `--max-p99-increase <MAX_P99_INCREASE>` | Max p99 increase per operation (%) · default `20` |
| `--max-p50-increase <MAX_P50_INCREASE>` | Max p50 increase per operation (%) · default `20` |
| `--min-latency-delta-ms <MIN_LATENCY_DELTA_MS>` | Ignore latency changes smaller than this (ms) · default `1` |
| `--max-throughput-drop <MAX_THROUGHPUT_DROP>` | Max throughput drop (%) · default `10` |
| `--max-error-increase <MAX_ERROR_INCREASE>` | Max increase of failed operations (percentage points) · default `0.5` |
| `--max-request-amp-increase <MAX_REQUEST_AMP_INCREASE>` | Max increase of requests per operation (%) · default `10` |
| `--max-read-amp-increase <MAX_READ_AMP_INCREASE>` | Max increase of read amplification (%) · default `10` |
| `--max-cost-increase <MAX_COST_INCREASE>` | Max increase of cost per operation (%) · default `10` |
| `--min-samples <MIN_SAMPLES>` | Minimum samples per operation for latency checks · default `30` |
| `--allow-throttling` | Do not fail when the candidate starts getting throttled |
| `--allow-workload-change` | Do not fail when the workload differs (preset, mix, dataset, access, rate) |
| `--allow-target-change` | Do not fail when the target differs (scheme, bucket/prefix, endpoint, options) |
| `--markdown <FILE>` | Write a Markdown summary (PR comment / job summary) |
| `--junit <FILE>` | Write JUnit XML |
| `--json <FILE>` | Write the comparison as JSON |

## `oprobe runs`

Saved runs: list, show, open, export, rm, gc

```text
oprobe runs [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

## `oprobe runs list`

List saved runs, newest first

```text
oprobe runs list [OPTIONS]
```

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `-n, --limit <LIMIT>` | Show at most N runs · default `20` |

## `oprobe runs show`

Show a run's full report (-o md|html|json for documents)

```text
oprobe runs show [OPTIONS] [RUNREF]
```

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `<RUNREF>` | Run id, id prefix, `last`, `last~N`, label, or path to a .oprobe / report .json file · default `last` |
| `--detail` | Every column, per-stage and per-verb breakdowns, the timeline and the 5 slowest operations |

## `oprobe runs open`

Open a run in the app (native window)

```text
oprobe runs open [OPTIONS] <RUNREF>
```

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `<RUNREF>` | Run id, id prefix, `last`, `last~N`, label, or path to a .oprobe / report .json file |

## `oprobe runs export`

Export a run (html, md, json, ndjson, csv, har, otlp)

```text
oprobe runs export [OPTIONS] --format <FORMAT> <RUNREF>
```

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `<RUNREF>` | Run id, id prefix, `last`, `last~N`, label, or path to a .oprobe file |
| `-f, --format <FORMAT>` | Export format · one of `json`, `ndjson`, `csv`, `har`, `otlp`, `md`, `html` |
| `--out <PATH>` | Write to this file (default: stdout) |
| `--endpoint <URL>` | OTLP/HTTP collector to push to (e.g. http://localhost:4318); with --format otlp |
| `--table <TABLE>` | CSV rows: requests or ops · default `requests` |
| `--signal <SIGNAL>` | OTLP signal: traces, metrics or all · default `all` |

## `oprobe runs rm`

Delete saved runs

```text
oprobe runs rm [OPTIONS] <RUNREF>...
```

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `<RUNREF>` | Runs to delete (RUNREFs) |

## `oprobe runs gc`

Delete old runs (keeps the newest and every baseline run)

```text
oprobe runs gc [OPTIONS]
```

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--keep <KEEP>` | Keep the newest N runs · default `50` |
| `--older-than <DURATION>` | Only delete runs older than this, e.g. 30d, 12h, 2w |
| `--dry-run` | Show what would be deleted |

## `oprobe analyze`

Re-slice a run by API, connection, remote, stage or second

```text
oprobe analyze [OPTIONS] [RUNREF]
```

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `<RUNREF>` | Run id, id prefix, `last`, `last~N`, label, or path to a .oprobe file · default `last` |
| `--by <KEY>` | Group requests by: api, conn, remote, stage, second, status |
| `--window <A..B>` | Only requests started in this window, seconds from the window start (e.g. 5..10) |
| `--where <K=V,…>` | Only requests matching all conditions, e.g. api=GetObject,status=503 (repeatable) |
| `--slowest <PCT>` | Attribute the slowest PCT percent of the (filtered) requests (default 1) |

## `oprobe explain`

Narrate a run's causes and advice, or document a finding code

```text
oprobe explain [OPTIONS] [RUNREF|FINDING_CODE]
```

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `<RUNREF\|FINDING_CODE>` | A RUNREF (id, prefix, `last`, `last~N`, label, .oprobe path) or a finding code (e.g. `throttling`); `oprobe explain --list` lists the codes |
| `--list` | List every finding code |
| `--top <TOP>` | Findings to narrate for a run · default `3` |

| `--credentials <CREDENTIALS>` | env \| profile:NAME \| anonymous |
| `--option <KEY=VALUE>` | OpenDAL option, repeatable (KEY=VALUE) |

## `oprobe doctor`

Check endpoint reachability, TLS, clock skew, credentials and permissions

```text
oprobe doctor [OPTIONS] [TARGET]
```

*Target*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `<TARGET>` | Target name (see `oprobe target list`) or storage URL: s3://bucket/prefix, gcs://bucket, azblob://container, oss://, cos://, b2://, fs:///path, memory:// |
| `-p, --profile <FILE>` | Load a profile (TOML); flags override its values |
| `--endpoint <ENDPOINT>` | Custom endpoint (MinIO, R2, Ceph, private clouds) |
| `--region <REGION>` | Region of the bucket (e.g. us-east-1); most S3-compatible services accept any value |
| `--option <KEY=VALUE>` | Extra backend option, repeatable (e.g. --option enable_virtual_host_style=true) |
| `--anonymous` | Access a public bucket without credentials (s3, gcs, azblob, oss: unsigned requests) |
| `--ca-cert <PEM>` | Trust an extra PEM CA bundle |
| `--insecure` | Skip TLS certificate verification (development only) |
| `--proxy <PROXY>` | Egress proxy URL, or `none` to ignore HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY |
| `--read-only` | Only check reachability and listing; never write |

## `oprobe probe`

Measure DNS / TCP / proxy / TLS handshakes and cold vs warm TTFB of an endpoint

```text
oprobe probe [OPTIONS] <ENDPOINT>
```

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `<ENDPOINT>` | http(s) endpoint, or a storage URL whose endpoint should be probed |
| `-n, --samples <SAMPLES>` | · default `5` |
| `--http <HTTP>` | · one of `auto`, `h1`, `h2` · default `auto` |
| `--get` | Use GET instead of HEAD for the cold/warm requests |
| `--timeout <TIMEOUT>` | · default `10s` |
| `--ca-cert <PEM>` |  |
| `--insecure` |  |
| `--proxy <PROXY>` |  |
| `--json <FILE>` | Also save the result as JSON |

## `oprobe watch`

Continuous low-rate probing with SLOs and a Prometheus endpoint

```text
oprobe watch [OPTIONS] [TARGET]
```

*Target*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `<TARGET>` | Target name (see `oprobe target list`) or storage URL: s3://bucket/prefix, gcs://bucket, azblob://container, oss://, cos://, b2://, fs:///path, memory:// |
| `-p, --profile <FILE>` | Load a profile (TOML); flags override its values |
| `--endpoint <ENDPOINT>` | Custom endpoint (MinIO, R2, Ceph, private clouds) |
| `--region <REGION>` | Region of the bucket (e.g. us-east-1); most S3-compatible services accept any value |
| `--option <KEY=VALUE>` | Extra backend option, repeatable (e.g. --option enable_virtual_host_style=true) |
| `--anonymous` | Access a public bucket without credentials (s3, gcs, azblob, oss: unsigned requests) |
| `--ca-cert <PEM>` | Trust an extra PEM CA bundle |
| `--insecure` | Skip TLS certificate verification (development only) |
| `--proxy <PROXY>` | Egress proxy URL, or `none` to ignore HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY |

*Workload*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--preset <PRESET>` | Workload preset: parquet, checkpoint, small-files, metadata, mixed |
| `-d, --duration <DURATION>` | Measurement window (e.g. 30s, 2m) |
| `--warmup <WARMUP>` | Warmup before measuring (connections, caches) |
| `--max-ops <MAX_OPS>` | Stop after N measured operations |
| `--rate <RATE>` | Open-loop arrival rate (ops/s); latency is measured from the intended start time |
| `--existing <PREFIX>` | Benchmark existing objects under this prefix (read-only) |
| `--objects <OBJECTS>` | Number of dataset objects to generate |
| `--object-size <OBJECT_SIZE>` | Size of each generated object (e.g. 16MiB) |
| `--access <ACCESS>` | Key popularity: uniform, zipf:1.1, hotset:0.2/0.8 |
| `--persist-dataset` | Keep the generated dataset for later runs (oprobe-dataset/<fingerprint>/) |
| `--no-verify` | Skip CRC32C verification |
| `--keep-data` | Do not delete test data when the run ends |

*Client knobs*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `-c, --concurrency <CONCURRENCY>` | Concurrent operations (workers) |
| `--io-concurrency <IO_CONCURRENCY>` | Per-operation reader/writer parallelism |
| `--chunk-size <CHUNK_SIZE>` | Reader/writer chunk and multipart part size (e.g. 8MiB) |
| `--range-gap <RANGE_GAP>` | Merge vectored ranges closer than this (e.g. 64KiB) |
| `--max-inflight <MAX_INFLIGHT>` | Cap in-flight HTTP requests (0 = unlimited) |
| `--http <HTTP>` | HTTP version · one of `auto`, `h1`, `h2` |
| `--no-keep-alive` | Open a new connection for every request |
| `--microscope` | Use oprobe's instrumented connection pool instead of OpenDAL's own HTTP client: exact pool queueing, per-dial DNS/TCP/proxy/TLS and HTTP/2 streams, at the cost of measuring a different client than production runs |
| `--cache <SIZE>` | Enable the in-memory read cache with this size (e.g. 512MiB) |
| `--retries <RETRIES>` | Retry attempts for temporary errors |
| `--tail-cut` | Cancel and retry straggler requests (TailCutLayer) |

*Cost*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--provider <PROVIDER>` | Pricing preset: aws-s3, gcs, azure-blob, cloudflare-r2, backblaze-b2, aliyun-oss |
| `--monthly-ops <MONTHLY_OPS>` | Logical operations per month to project costs for |
| `--egress-fraction <EGRESS_FRACTION>` | Fraction of downloads leaving the cloud (0..1) |
| `--stored-gib <STORED_GIB>` | Stored data in GiB |

*Safety*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | Print the plan (requests, bytes, objects written/deleted, cost, ETA) and exit |
| `--read-only` | Refuse every write and delete (exit 5); implied by --existing |
| `--max-cost-usd <USD>` | Stop when the estimated request cost exceeds this (USD; exit 4) |
| `--max-requests <N>` | Stop after this many backend requests (exit 4) |
| `--max-bytes <SIZE>` | Stop after transferring this many bytes, e.g. 10GiB (exit 4) |
| `--max-duration <DURATION>` | Stop after this much wall time, e.g. 5m (exit 4) |
| `--idempotency-key <KEY>` | Name the run prefix after KEY: a retried command reuses and cleans it up |

*Watch*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--interval <INTERVAL>` | Time between probe windows (each window lasts --duration, default 5s) · default `10s` |
| `--window <WINDOW>` | Rolling window the SLOs are evaluated over · default `5m` |
| `--slo <SLO>` | Service level objective, repeatable: p99<200ms, p50<50ms, errors<1%, throttle<1%, availability>99.9% |
| `--listen <ADDR>` | Serve Prometheus metrics on ADDR (/metrics), e.g. 127.0.0.1:9464 |
| `--otlp-endpoint <URL>` | Push OTLP metrics after every window (collector base URL, e.g. http://localhost:4318) |
| `--count <N>` | Stop after N probe windows (default: until Ctrl-C) |

## `oprobe matrix`

Run the same workload across targets / knob values and rank them

```text
oprobe matrix [OPTIONS] [TARGET]
```

*Target*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `<TARGET>` | Target name (see `oprobe target list`) or storage URL: s3://bucket/prefix, gcs://bucket, azblob://container, oss://, cos://, b2://, fs:///path, memory:// |
| `-p, --profile <FILE>` | Load a profile (TOML); flags override its values |
| `--endpoint <ENDPOINT>` | Custom endpoint (MinIO, R2, Ceph, private clouds) |
| `--region <REGION>` | Region of the bucket (e.g. us-east-1); most S3-compatible services accept any value |
| `--option <KEY=VALUE>` | Extra backend option, repeatable (e.g. --option enable_virtual_host_style=true) |
| `--anonymous` | Access a public bucket without credentials (s3, gcs, azblob, oss: unsigned requests) |
| `--ca-cert <PEM>` | Trust an extra PEM CA bundle |
| `--insecure` | Skip TLS certificate verification (development only) |
| `--proxy <PROXY>` | Egress proxy URL, or `none` to ignore HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY |

*Workload*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--preset <PRESET>` | Workload preset: parquet, checkpoint, small-files, metadata, mixed |
| `-d, --duration <DURATION>` | Measurement window (e.g. 30s, 2m) |
| `--warmup <WARMUP>` | Warmup before measuring (connections, caches) |
| `--max-ops <MAX_OPS>` | Stop after N measured operations |
| `--rate <RATE>` | Open-loop arrival rate (ops/s); latency is measured from the intended start time |
| `--existing <PREFIX>` | Benchmark existing objects under this prefix (read-only) |
| `--objects <OBJECTS>` | Number of dataset objects to generate |
| `--object-size <OBJECT_SIZE>` | Size of each generated object (e.g. 16MiB) |
| `--access <ACCESS>` | Key popularity: uniform, zipf:1.1, hotset:0.2/0.8 |
| `--persist-dataset` | Keep the generated dataset for later runs (oprobe-dataset/<fingerprint>/) |
| `--no-verify` | Skip CRC32C verification |
| `--keep-data` | Do not delete test data when the run ends |

*Client knobs*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `-c, --concurrency <CONCURRENCY>` | Concurrent operations (workers) |
| `--io-concurrency <IO_CONCURRENCY>` | Per-operation reader/writer parallelism |
| `--chunk-size <CHUNK_SIZE>` | Reader/writer chunk and multipart part size (e.g. 8MiB) |
| `--range-gap <RANGE_GAP>` | Merge vectored ranges closer than this (e.g. 64KiB) |
| `--max-inflight <MAX_INFLIGHT>` | Cap in-flight HTTP requests (0 = unlimited) |
| `--http <HTTP>` | HTTP version · one of `auto`, `h1`, `h2` |
| `--no-keep-alive` | Open a new connection for every request |
| `--microscope` | Use oprobe's instrumented connection pool instead of OpenDAL's own HTTP client: exact pool queueing, per-dial DNS/TCP/proxy/TLS and HTTP/2 streams, at the cost of measuring a different client than production runs |
| `--cache <SIZE>` | Enable the in-memory read cache with this size (e.g. 512MiB) |
| `--retries <RETRIES>` | Retry attempts for temporary errors |
| `--tail-cut` | Cancel and retry straggler requests (TailCutLayer) |

*Cost*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--provider <PROVIDER>` | Pricing preset: aws-s3, gcs, azure-blob, cloudflare-r2, backblaze-b2, aliyun-oss |
| `--monthly-ops <MONTHLY_OPS>` | Logical operations per month to project costs for |
| `--egress-fraction <EGRESS_FRACTION>` | Fraction of downloads leaving the cloud (0..1) |
| `--stored-gib <STORED_GIB>` | Stored data in GiB |

*SLA (exit code 3 when breached)*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--sla <MODE>` | `none` reports the SLA verdict without failing the command · one of `enforce`, `none` |
| `--max-error-rate <RATE>` | Max share of failed operations, e.g. 1% or 0.01 (default 1%) |
| `--max-throttle-rate <RATE>` | Max share of throttled (429/503) operations, e.g. 0% (default: not checked by `run`; `tune` rejects any throttling) |
| `--p99-ms <MS>` | Max p99 latency per operation in ms (tune rejects trials above it) |

*Safety*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | Print the plan (requests, bytes, objects written/deleted, cost, ETA) and exit |
| `--read-only` | Refuse every write and delete (exit 5); implied by --existing |
| `--max-cost-usd <USD>` | Stop when the estimated request cost exceeds this (USD; exit 4) |
| `--max-requests <N>` | Stop after this many backend requests (exit 4) |
| `--max-bytes <SIZE>` | Stop after transferring this many bytes, e.g. 10GiB (exit 4) |
| `--max-duration <DURATION>` | Stop after this much wall time, e.g. 5m (exit 4) |
| `--idempotency-key <KEY>` | Name the run prefix after KEY: a retried command reuses and cleans it up |

*Matrix*

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--targets <A,B>` | Targets to compare (names or URLs, comma-separated or repeated) |
| `--vary <KNOB=V1,V2>` | A knob and its values, repeatable: concurrency=8,16,32 · http=h1,h2 · addressing=virtual,path · io_concurrency · chunk_size · range_gap · max_inflight · keep_alive=on,off · cache=off,256MiB · retries · tail_cut=on,off · preset |
| `--rank-by <RANK_BY>` | Rank cells by throughput, mib, p50, p99 or cost · default `throughput` |
| `--label <LABEL>` | Label of the stored runs (default matrix-<id>) |

## `oprobe lab`

Start a local S3-compatible server with programmable faults

Aliases: serve-s3

```text
oprobe lab [OPTIONS]
```

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--bind <BIND>` | · default `127.0.0.1:9000` |
| `--tls` | Serve HTTPS (certificate for localhost / 127.0.0.1) |
| `--h1-only` | Disable HTTP/2 |
| `--latency <LATENCY>` | Added time-to-first-byte for every request (e.g. 20ms) · default `0ms` |
| `--straggler-every <STRAGGLER_EVERY>` | Make every Nth request a straggler · default `0` |
| `--straggler <STRAGGLER>` | Extra delay for stragglers · default `200ms` |
| `--throttle-above <THROTTLE_ABOVE>` | Return 503 SlowDown when more than N requests are in flight |
| `--throttle-every <THROTTLE_EVERY>` | Throttle every Nth request |
| `--throttle-status <THROTTLE_STATUS>` | Status code used for throttling (429 or 503) · default `503` |
| `--bandwidth-kib <BANDWIDTH_KIB>` | Cap response bandwidth per request (KiB/s) |
| `--throttle-early-close` | Answer throttled requests without reading the upload and close the connection (as real gateways do), so clients see resets mid-upload |
| `--complete-delay <COMPLETE_DELAY>` | Delay for CompleteMultipartUpload · default `0ms` |
| `--write-ca <FILE>` | Write the lab CA certificate (for --ca-cert) to this file |

## `oprobe mcp`

MCP server for agents (stdio, or --http ADDR)

```text
oprobe mcp [OPTIONS]
```

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--http <ADDR>` | Serve MCP over Streamable HTTP on this address (e.g. 127.0.0.1:8765) instead of stdio |
| `--allow-write` | Enable tools that write test data (runs that upload a dataset, tune, cleanup) |
| `--allow-target <NAME\|URL-PREFIX>` | Only these targets: a configured target name or a URL prefix (repeatable) |
| `--max-cost-usd <USD>` | Budget applied to every run the server starts: estimated request cost (USD) |
| `--max-requests <N>` | Budget applied to every run: backend requests |
| `--max-bytes <SIZE>` | Budget applied to every run: bytes transferred (e.g. 1GiB) |
| `--max-duration <DURATION>` | Budget applied to every run: wall time (e.g. 2m) |
| `--max-concurrent-runs <MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS>` | Runs executing at the same time (others wait) · default `1` |

| argument | description |

| `-p, --profile <FILE>` | Load a profile (TOML); flags override its values |
| `--endpoint <ENDPOINT>` | Custom endpoint (MinIO, R2, Ceph, private clouds) |
| `--region <REGION>` | Region of the bucket (e.g. us-east-1); most S3-compatible services accept any value |
| `--option <KEY=VALUE>` | Extra backend option, repeatable (e.g. --option enable_virtual_host_style=true) |
| `--anonymous` | Access a public bucket without credentials (s3, gcs, azblob, oss: unsigned requests) |
| `--ca-cert <PEM>` | Trust an extra PEM CA bundle |

| `--datasets` | Also remove persisted datasets (oprobe-dataset/) |
| `--dry-run` | Show what would be deleted |
| `--read-only` | Refuse to delete anything (implies --dry-run) |

## `oprobe self-update`

Check, download, verify and install the latest release

```text
oprobe self-update [OPTIONS]
```

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--check` | Only check whether a newer release exists (exit 0 either way) |
| `--to <TAG>` | Install this release tag instead of the latest (e.g. v3.0.1) |
| `--force` | Reinstall even when already on that version |

## `oprobe completions`

Generate shell completions

```text
oprobe completions [OPTIONS] <SHELL>
```

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `<SHELL>` | · one of `bash`, `elvish`, `fish`, `powershell`, `zsh` |

## `oprobe man`

Generate the man page

```text
oprobe man [OPTIONS]
```

| argument | description |
|---|---|
| `--out-dir <OUT_DIR>` | Output directory (one page per command) |
| `--markdown` | Print the CLI reference as Markdown instead (docs/cli.md) |
